newsitem.title: FINLAND: ESPOON SAHKO TO HAVE ROLE IN GRID MERGER.
newsitem.headline: ESPOON SAHKO TO HAVE ROLE IN GRID MERGER.

text.p: Finnish regional electricity grid operator said in a statement on Friday it would take a minority stake in the company to be formed through a planned merger of regional grids Savon Voima and Kuopion Energia.
It said Espoon Sahko, the owners of Savon Voima and the city of Kuopio had agreed on the merger and on Espoon Sahko's role as a minority owner in the new company.
"Espoon Sahko's board and the other parties' administrative bodies will proceed ... in the next few weeks," it said. It gave no further details.
